card.name: End of a cell in dosing tables
card.fires_on: The last word or number of an entry in a flattened dosing table, such as hours, mL, daily or Dose. The next table cell or column heading follows with no punctuation.

modes.label: Frequency or unit ends a cell
modes.description: Words like hours, daily, mL or h that close a dose or interval entry before the next column.
modes.example: 400 mg every 8 hours OR 600 mg every 12<< hours>> Pediatric Patients Less Than 2 Months of

modes.label: Column heading or number ends a cell
modes.description: The last piece of a header or numeric entry in a table, such as Dose, GFR or a decimal digit.
modes.example: Renal Impairment/Estimated G<<FR>> Dosage Modification GFR greater than or

card.writes: It promotes an asterisk, as for a footnote marker after a table entry, and suppresses quote marks and odd symbols.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a box in a dosing table, just before the next box begins.
